package courseplan

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func GenerateCourseContent(
	ctx context.Context,
	generator domainservice.ContentGenerator,
	requestID string,
	course domain.GeneratedCourse,
	normalizedContext json.RawMessage,
	beforeLesson ...func(context.Context) error,
) (domain.GeneratedCourse, error) {
	if generator == nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	var courseContext map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(normalizedContext, &courseContext); err != nil {
		return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for moduleIndex := range course.Modules {
		for sectionIndex := range course.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections {
			lessons := course.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Lessons
			for lessonIndex := range lessons {
				if len(beforeLesson) > 0 && beforeLesson[0] != nil {
					if err := beforeLesson[0](ctx); err != nil {
						return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
					}
				}
				lesson := &lessons[lessonIndex]
				key := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(
					requestID+"\x00"+course.Fingerprint+"\x00"+moduleCode(course, moduleIndex)+"\x00"+
						sectionCode(course, moduleIndex, sectionIndex)+"\x00"+lesson.Code,
				)).String()
				generated, err := generator.GenerateLesson(ctx, domainservice.LessonGenerationInput{
					CourseContext: courseContext, Lesson: *lesson, Language: course.Language,
				}, key)
				if err != nil {
					return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
				}
				if err := normalizeGeneratedLessonContent(&generated); err != nil {
					return domain.GeneratedCourse{}, err
				}
				lesson.DescriptionMarkdown = generated.DescriptionMarkdown
				lesson.Examples = generated.Examples
				lesson.Tasks = generated.KnowledgeChecks
				lesson.Status = domain.LessonStatusActive
			}
		}
	}
	course.Status = domain.CourseStatusActive
	return course, nil
}

func normalizeGeneratedLessonContent(content *domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent) error {
	content.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(content.DescriptionMarkdown)
	if content.DescriptionMarkdown == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(content.DescriptionMarkdown) > 64000 ||
		len(content.Examples) == 0 || len(content.Examples) > 12 ||
		len(content.KnowledgeChecks) == 0 || len(content.KnowledgeChecks) > 12 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for index := range content.Examples {
		example := &content.Examples[index]
		example.Title = strings.TrimSpace(example.Title)
		example.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(example.DescriptionMarkdown)
		example.PrimaryStack = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(example.PrimaryStack))
		example.Stacks = normalizeGeneratedStrings(example.Stacks, 16)
		example.TargetConcepts = normalizeGeneratedStrings(example.TargetConcepts, 32)
		if example.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(example.Title) > 255 || example.DescriptionMarkdown == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(example.DescriptionMarkdown) > 32000 || len(example.Stacks) == 0 ||
			len(example.TargetConcepts) == 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	for index := range content.KnowledgeChecks {
		check := &content.KnowledgeChecks[index]
		check.Title = strings.TrimSpace(check.Title)
		check.DescriptionMarkdown = strings.TrimSpace(check.DescriptionMarkdown)
		check.ExpectedAnswers = normalizeGeneratedStrings(check.ExpectedAnswers, 20)
		if check.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(check.Title) > 255 || check.DescriptionMarkdown == "" ||
			utf8.RuneCountInString(check.DescriptionMarkdown) > 16000 || len(check.ExpectedAnswers) == 0 {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// NormalizeGeneratedLessonContent is the shared strict parser boundary for
// both legacy whole-course generation and S9's per-lesson checkpoint workflow.
func NormalizeGeneratedLessonContent(content *domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent) error {
	return normalizeGeneratedLessonContent(content)
}

func normalizeGeneratedStrings(inputs []string, maximum int) []string {
	if len(inputs) > maximum {
		return nil
	}
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(inputs))
	result := make([]string, 0, len(inputs))
	for _, input := range inputs {
		value := strings.TrimSpace(input)
		if value == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(value) > 2000 {
			return nil
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result
}

func moduleCode(course domain.GeneratedCourse, index int) string { return course.Modules[index].Code }

func sectionCode(course domain.GeneratedCourse, moduleIndex int, sectionIndex int) string {
	return course.Modules[moduleIndex].Sections[sectionIndex].Code
}
